newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's mortgage bank issues $26.8 mln bonds.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's mortgage bank issues $26.8 mln bonds.

text.p: Morocco's Credit Hotelier et Immobilier issued on Friday 250 million dirhams ($26.8 million) bonds in 15-year state-guaranteed debenture bonds at a rate of 10.25 percent.
The bank which is listed on the Casablanca stock exchange announced the issue in a newspaper.
The par value of the bond is 150,000 dirhams.
The CIH new bonds issue brought to 1.3 billion dirhams the total value of debentures since March last year.
The bank is on a list of 114 state-companies to be privatised before 1998.
CIH last traded on March 20 at 315 dirhams.
